Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been more than two months since a young mother of two, Susan Powell, vanished without a trace. Susan’s husband, Josh, is now a person of interest in this case but her family claims he refuses to cooperate with police. Dr. Phil speaks with the missing woman's parents, Chuck and Judy. Learn what they have to say about what they conclude is odd behavior of Susan’s husband and why say they fear for their grandchildren. A Dr. Phil field producer travels to the camp area where Josh allegedly took his sons after midnight the night Susan disappeared. Don’t miss what she discovers! And, legal analyst Lisa Bloom weighs in on this case. Next, Ed Smart, whose daughter, Elizabeth, was kidnapped and found, knows what it’s like to be a person of interest like Josh. Hear what he says. Plus, a father whose daughter, Kimberly Medina, has been missing for 14 years shares the mistakes he thinks he’s made and has a strong message for Chuck and Judy about their grandchildren. Go behind the headlines in this heartbreaking story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two families desperate to find their missing children ask Dr. Phil for help. Two-year-old Bianca disappeared while in the care of her father. He says she was taken when he was carjacked. Was he involved in her disappearance? And, Josh hasn’t seen his son, Trenton, since he was 2 years old, more than five years ago. Did the boy's mother, who died by suicide, take clues with her to the grave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Elizabeth and her husband, Bob, claim that Elizabeth’s 20-year-old daughter, Ali, is a “spoiled brat,” who refuses to go to college or get a job, has trashed their house and also steals from them. Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ali about her behavior -- and for the parents, who admit they’ve enabled their daughter. Can Ali learn to stand on her own two feet?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alex says he will do absolutely anything to live his “bad and boujee” lifestyle. He admits he lies, cheats, and steals thousands of dollars from friends, family, and even strangers, just so he can live a lifestyle which includes shopping, tanning, and getting his hair done. Alex says he wants to become famous for his “twerking videos,” but until then, he believes his family should be taking care of him because he’s “just 26-year-old!” Alex’s mother, Kimberly, and sister, Elizabeth, say nothing about Alex’s life is glamorous, and claim he's addicted to drugs and a criminal. They claim Alex shows no remorse for any of his actions, even though he has stolen so much from his mother that she claims she will be homeless within the year! Can Dr. Phil get through to Alex? Will Alex ever change his “bad and boujee” ways? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There comes a point when every child must grow up and face life on their own. For today’s guests, that time has come and gone and they want stay with Mom and Dad! You’ll meet Ryan, whose father says he’s borrowed over $10,000, and has trouble standing on his own two feet. And watch as Dr. Phil gives another young adult the tools she needs to create a life of her own. Find out what needs to happen before your offspring fly the coop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores potential new clues in the separate cold cases of Ashley Summers and Michelle Parker, who have been missing for several years. What happened to these women? Plus, “Homeless Joe” returns to Dr. Phil -- how is he now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In Part 3 of the Man Camp Series, couples fighting to save their marrages deal with family issues, infidelity, and unexpected visitors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples who say their marriage is on the rocks due to debt.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jaime says she divorced her allegedly abusive husband, Jay, after two years of marriage but says he refuses to let her go and lures her back with promises to change. Jay says Jaime pushes his buttons until he blows up. Can this couple save their relationship for the sake of their child, or are they better off apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meddling moms who track and monitor their children's lives.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil wants a violent teen to meet someone who could change her life. How will she react?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Statistics show that 2,000 teens get pregnant every day. Moms and dads: Watch this show with your teenagers, because it can impact their lives and yours! Two families face off over who should raise baby Miley. Paige, 17, and her boyfriend, Jordan, 18, are determined to raise their child on their own, even though they live with Jordan’s dad, Chris. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a relative scheming to get money from a rich aunt, uncle or even parents when they pass away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil debates viewers who disagree with the advice he gave to previous guests. One woman feels he had no right to push his view of adoption on pregnant 15-year-old, Alexandra. Another woman accuses Dr. Phil of bullying the participants on the Weight Loss Challenge and even accuses him of disliking fat people! What does Dr. Phil say about her inflated accusations? Then a 16-year-old bi-racial girl disputes Dr. Phil’s advice to a mother facing a racial identity crisis. How will these viewers fare when they go head to head with Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your pregnant teen daughter running away to be with the baby's father -- an older man whom she met online. For Heidi, this became reality when her 15-year-old daughter, Brittney, went missing for five weeks. Dr. Phil put private investigator and former FBI Agent Harold Copus on the case to find the missing teen. See the confrontation when Harold finally locates her and her 34-year-old boyfriend. Then, find out why Brittney was even more upset when she found out what was in store for her. It's been two months; has Brittney's relationship with her mother improved? Next, Kim, 15, has run away six times in the last year, most recently making it halfway across the country to be with her married boyfriend. Why didn't her parents look for her, and why does she say she'll do anything to get away from them? Can this family learn to get things back on track? Think your child is being targeted by a sexual predator? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s warning signs!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: With the economy in trouble, a lot of people are under pressure and getting desperate. Learn the tools to protect yourself from liars, cheats and scammers who are trying to take advantage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Terrell Owens is a six-time NFL pro-bowler and arguably one of the best wide receivers to play the game, but he may be better known for his antics off the field. His tumultuous career has been well-documented, and he's been called arrogant, toxic and friendless. The football great sits down with Dr. Phil to set the record straight about the bad rap he says he’s been getting, especially from the mothers of three of his children, who claim he's also a deadbeat dad who is behind on child support payments and makes little attempt to see his kids. What does Terrell think of their accusations? See what happens when the moms come together to confront the alleged absentee dad on Dr. Phil's stage about missed birthday parties, ignored phone calls and empty promises. Is Terrell living in the lap of luxury while his kids go without? What kind of relationship does he want with his children? Dr. Phil delves into Terrell's past to help him create a better future for his children. Plus, at 38, will he play in the NFL again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says her mother, Patricia, claims she is defying the odds by becoming a record-setting weight lifter while simultaneously battling Stage 3 brain cancer. But Jessica insists her mother isn’t sick at all and that she is lying about her health to gain sympathy and attention. She says Patricia has been spinning stories about various medical ailments for as long as she can remember -- and it’s time to come clean. Patricia strongly denies her daughter’s accusations and insists her diagnosis and incredible survival story are real. Why does she claim Jessica is out to get her? Emotions run high when mother and daughter meet on Dr. Phil’s stage. Do Patricia’s claims hold up? And, can this mother and daughter repair their fractured relationship?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brenda says she fell in love with and married her husband, Don – despite their 26-year age gap. But soon after, she claims her “Prince Charming” turned “crazy” and “temperamental.” Is their age difference at the root of their issues? Then, Bev says she’s concerned for her sister, Melanie, who married her much younger man, Devar, after meeting him on a Jamaican vacation. Is Devar in it for love, or for a green card and money? And, Dr. Phil catches up with best-selling author Mitch Albom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Desperate for help with their drug-addicted 21-year-old son, Doug and Debbie ask Dr. Phil to prepare them for an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's been weeks since Brandon's intervention and reluctant agreement to check into a drug treatment facility. Now, he and his family speak with Dr. Phil as they start the lifelong marathon of recovery.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Screaming, making excuses, irrational outbursts ... No one knows how a drug addict behaves better than Brandon. With five years of sobriety under his belt, he and his mother, Debbie, are paying it forward. Now, Brandon meets his match! After seeing Dr. Phil’s intervention with Karli, Kim wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old daughter, Jaime, who's addicted to OxyContin. Five months ago, Kim’s family performed an intervention with Jaime. After agreeing to go to a detox facility, Jaime checked herself out and tried to commit suicide. Now, Kim says the young woman has started injecting cocaine and takes any opiate she can get her hands on. Don’t miss the most dramatic intervention yet. Will Jaime finally agree to get treatment, or will she fight everyone tooth and nail? Plus, addicted to heroin and OxyContin, Karli had overdosed and relapsed many times before her mother brought her to Dr. Phil and Brandon for help. How is she now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes goes inside the unthinkable: making your own child sick to fulfill a disturbing need for attention. The idea might sound unimaginable, but for people with a psychological disorder called Munchausen by Proxy, it's irresistible. Note: Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman says her ex-husband enables their daughter's addiction.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman believes she's going to be Vladimir Putin's wife.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shara claims that her newlywed husband, Luke, is a “mean, insecure know-it-all” who won’t let her own a cell phone, hold a job or leave the house alone -- and also dictates how she should dress and wear her makeup. Luke denies all of Shara’s allegations and claims that she is “no angel” and has a vicious temper. Can this marriage be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can Dr. Phil convince a 24 yo NYU grad that he’s not a cyborg from the future?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a nosy loved one in your life snooping through your things, questioning your every move and driving you crazy? Dr. Phil has advice.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melinda and Amy claim their lives have been turned upside down by a social media influencer and political activist named Paloma, who they say has subjected them to nine months of cyberbullying and harassment. Paloma says they’ve got it all wrong and that she is the victim of their cyberbullying. Who is the real victim? Will Dr. Phil convince these three women to “log off” from each other? Find out in this explosive episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mary’s 30-year-old daughter, Lynn, claims to be suffering from numerous medical conditions, including stomach cancer, heart disease, uterine cancer, rheumatoid arthritis and other ailments -- but Mary believes it’s all lies, concocted to gain money and attention. Mary says she has found no evidence of her daughter’s health conditions and was horrified to learn that Lynn had created a crowdfunding website, asking for donations for medical expenses. Lynn insists she’s gravely ill and says it sickens her even more that her mother doesn’t believe her. The mother and daughter face each other for the first time in a year on Dr. Phil’s stage. Dr. Phil reviews Lynn’s medical records -- how does she explain the inconsistencies? And, how can Lynn find a return to health and start living again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every bride wants to shine on her special day -- from wearing the perfect gown to hosting the most extravagant reception. But what happens when the dream of the perfect wedding turns into a nightmare? Janae knows about this pain firsthand. Her husband, Michael, got so drunk before the ceremony that he passed out cold after saying “I do” and didn’t wake up until the next day! Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? Then, Angela is a self-professed bridezilla who makes no excuses for her demanding ways. She even created a newsletter for her bridesmaids with the rules and regulations they must follow to participate in her wedding! Her sister and maid of honor, Vanessa, worries that Angela's nitpicking will cause her fiancé, Marvin, to run for the hills. What's behind Angela's controlling behavior, and is she headed for heartache on her special day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. Jessica says she believes this reality show "celebrity" is not only a deadbeat dad but an abusive, manipulating narcissist who is acting inappropriately with his female fans and firmly believes he cheated on her with Katie, a co-star from Redneck Island. Jason says Jessica knew he was wild from the start and failed to tame his bad boy ways. He admits he’s called Jessica names but adamantly denies he’s ever been physically abusive toward her. Jason says Jessica needs to stop using their son as a manipulative tool, because they are not together. Jason 100 percent denies cheating with Katie on season 5 of Redneck Island, but Katie says otherwise -- and in a shocking revelation, Katie reveals the full truth to Jessica. Will Jason continue to deny the affair or finally admit to cheating?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever feel nervous before posting on social media? Have you ever censored your own thoughts because you worry that you could be criticized or even canceled for posting your beliefs? Dr. Phil and his guests discuss the self-censorship debate on the internet and social media, including the fundamental misunderstanding about the true extent of “freedom of speech” under the First Amendment. Kimberly, a University of Tennessee doctoral candidate, claims her college violated her freedom of speech after a professional conduct committee determined that she had posted unprofessional content to her social media. What rights do colleges have to spy on personal social media posts? Also Tehran Von Ghasri, a comedian who performs on college campuses, says cancel culture gone too far. How does the fear of being canceled affects the jokes he performs for college students or content he posts online? Alexandra, a social media influencer and business owner, says giving opinions about COVID got her censored and three accounts closed. What did she say to get canceled? Dr. Phil also talks with Attorney Robert Shibley, a Senior Fellow at the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE), who says over half of Americans are not saying how they feel for fear of offending others or being canceled. Jessica Levinson, an attorney and a Clinical Professor of Law at Loyola Law School, provides an explanation on the boundaries of the First Amendment. And, Gabrielle Gambrell, a Columbia University and NYU professor, says that social media sites are obligated to monitor hate and dangerous speech. Plus, find out which emojis you are probably using right now are deemed outdated or inappropriate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A self destructive teen or a bad role model for a Mom? Who is telling the truth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there something you’ve been hanging on to for just a little too long? Clothes you haven’t fit into since high school? Boxes of stuff you haven’t looked at in years? Dr. Phil’s guests say their loved ones need to call the junk yard and “Get rid of it!” Kim says her husband, Paul’s, Star Warshobby has to go. With over 6,000 pieces in his collection, Paul spends 30 hours a week playing with his action figures, building models and talking to friends about Star Wars. He even had a light saber sword fight at their wedding, so shouldn’t Kim have known what she was getting into? Next, Larry and Sheila married four months ago, but Sheila says she had no idea she was getting hitched to a hoarder. Larry says she’s got it all wrong -– she’s the pack rat! With some of their favorite collections rolled out on stage, can Dr. Phil help them negotiate what goes and what stays? Plus, meet Terri, who has four storage units and two garages full of sentimental memories -– like a rubber chicken and her father’s spine X-rays! She spends so much money storing her stuff, that she can’t even afford health insurance. What’s at the heart of her hoarding? Don’t miss this hilarious look at how collections can get out of control!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda Knox spent four years locked in an Italian prison for the murder of her British roommate Meredith Kercher. Dubbed “Foxy Knoxy” by the press, she became one of the most famous cases of wrongful conviction. She tells her story, as she fights to save the life of Texas death row inmate Rodney Reed. This program contains graphic discussion about a criminal case. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents: If your teen talks back, acts out or is just plain rude, you better tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you get married, you look forward to a life filled with love, happiness and security. But what if you find out your spouse has been telling you lies and is someone completely different than the person you thought you knew?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with Jamie, a fitness model who admits he has struggled with drug and alcohol addiction for years. Jamie’s brother, Anthony, says their parents have enabled Jamie at every turn -- including failing to acknowledge Jamie’s other serious problem, which he refuses to discuss. After storming off stage, Jamie rejoins the conversation. Is he ready to be completely honest with his family -- and with himself? Dr. Phil has a sobering wake-up call for Jamie -- and for his parents. Will Jamie finally get the help he needs to get clean -- and stay clean for good?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Just one day off heroin, Sarah is monitored medically as she goes through painful withdrawal symptoms. Tecoa has been clean for two weeks, but struggles with her own drug cravings while six months pregnant and providing support for her detoxing sibling. Is she sabotaging Dr. Phil's efforts to get Sarah healthy? Dr. Phil shows Sarah and Tecoa a terrifying look into their future. Is it enough to scare them straight?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil addresses Cindy's impact on Tecoa's sobriety and reunites Sarah and Tecoa with their estranged father.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman da vida a Harvey, un hombre que acaba de quedarse sin trabajo y que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija. Para colmo de males, lo han alojado solo en un hotel, mientras el resto de la familia comparte una casa, y su hija quiere que sea su padrastro quien la lleve al altar. Pero conoce a Kate, una peculiar mujer que puede hacer que su viaje a Londres merezca la pena

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Willa Davis es propietaria de una tienda de mascotas en San Francisco. Un día se reencuentra con el chico que la dejó plantada en el instituto, y tendrá que luchar con todas sus fuerzas contra su propio corazón para no volver a enamorarse, diez años después.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: Años 60. Sally Cauffield (Sharon Stone) es una estadounidense casada con Leo Cauffield (Rupert Everett), un inglés que lleva una doble vida: es periodista y agente de la KGB. Cuando, tras varios años de matrimonio, Leo desaparece, Sally lo busca y cuando lo encuentra se entera de que es un espía cuyo nombre en clave es “El Tercer Hombre”.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo llamado Thomas y dos adorables hijos. Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: Navidad A La Vuelta De La Esquina
programme.desc: Claire, una experta capitalista de riesgo de la ciudad, escapa a un pueblo pintoresco durante las vacaciones y se convierte en invitada de la librería Fortenbury. A su llegada, Claire descubre que las celebraciones navideñas han sido canceladas después de una inundación y la librería está en muy mal estado.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: En la Alemania de antes de la Primera Guerra Mundial, un joven se enamora de la esposa de su jefe, desatando un romance prohibido.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Dos compañeros de trabajo con una intensa rivalidad se ven obligados a colaborar, descubriendo que el odio y el amor están más cerca de lo que pensaban.

programme.title: Juegos de la Vida
programme.desc: Una pareja de pocos recursos económicos en un barrio habanero acuerda hacerse un regalo en su aniversario.

programme.title: Recuerdos De Navidad
programme.desc: Después de años de vivir bajo la excesiva obsesión navideña de su madre, Noelle abandonó la Navidad y comenzó un nuevo capítulo en su vida al mudarse a la ciudad para concentrarse en su carrera. Convirtiéndose en una adicta al trabajo, su jefe la obliga a tomar un descanso para irse a casa y disfrutar de la temporada navideña.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Comedia romántica acerca de dos amigos de la infancia que se reúnen despues de muchos años. Uno de ellos le pide al otro que finja ser judío para conquistar a una chica judía.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas entre Navidad y Año Nuevo, tres hermanas viajan a la encantadora ciudad de Sopot para replantearse su vida amorosa. Todo cambia cuando sus exnovios aparecen buscando una segunda oportunidad.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo que hoy su hijo Jonah quiere ir a una fiesta universitaria, su mujer va a traer a casa a su anciano padre para vivir con ellos, y su jefe parece haberse vuelto más loco y exigente de lo normal. Si puede soportar un día como el de hoy, Ned podrá aguantar cualquier cosa que le depare su vida.

programme.title: Las Seductoras
programme.desc: Max y su hija Page son dos timadoras profesionales que utilizan sus dotes de seducción para estafar a millonarios. Pero, en una ocasión, mientras Max intenta embaucar a un excéntrico magnate del tabaco, Page conoce a un simpático chico y se enamora de él.

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix), un soltero que ha regresado al piso de sus padres en Brooklyn, empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), tan bella como voluble, de la que se enamora locamente, lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar la tranquila vida que se le planteaba… Festival de Cannes 2008, Nominada a la Palma de Oro. Premios César 2009, Nominada la Mejor Película Extranjera. Premio Sant Jordi 2011 al Mejor Actor Extranjero (Joaquin Phoenix).

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: Carlos, príncipe de una corona centroeuropea, llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso. María, que trabaja en la clínica veterinaria de su padre, conoce a Carlos por casualidad. Los dos ocultan su verdadera identidad y establecen una relación muy especial. Pronto se descubren sus mentiras mutuas. Carlos descubre que María tiene una hija y María se entera de la condición principesca de Carlos por unas fotos publicadas en la prensa sensacionalista.

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Jorge es músico, lo despiden tratando de encontrar una melodía entre el ruido de la calle, el mismo día que mueren su esposa y su hijo menor. Debe parecer cuerdo para cuidar de su hijo mayor Lucas, de lo contrario también lo perderá.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Hace diez años, una muchacha presenció con impotencia el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque y convirtiéndose en algo que los cazadores nunca hallaráan: un lobo. Ahora, a pesar de que vive al otro lado del mundo, Vivian Gandillon sigue huyendo.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un reconocido chef de Londres disfruta del éxito profesional hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo y abrir un pequeño restaurante en el campo. Así conocerá a Kate, una crítica gastronómica, que le ayudará a creer nuevamente en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de Tod Lubitch, un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico y que debe crecer y permanecer toda su vida confinado en un ambiente estéril. Pero se enamora y deberá elegir entre vivir plenamente o confinado.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de “Paris, je t’aime” (2006), doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como plató y narran diferentes historias de amor en esta película coral.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Cada año 150.000 amantes del motor viajan al desierto de Navada para asistir al SEMA de Las Vegas, la más célebre exposición de automóviles tuneados del mundo. Entre ellos está la periodista Kati que se reúne con el experto en tuneo Dirk Hattenhauer, busca las últimas tendencias y conoce a algunas celebridades de este mundo, como el tuneador John D'Agostino y Ken Block.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El SEMA Show de Las Vegas es la mayor y más conocida exposición de automóviles personalizados del mundo. Todo está presente, desde los coches de exhibición reconstruidos de forma compleja hasta los gigantescos 4x4. Y en la fiesta posterior al espectáculo “SEMA Ignited”, hacen que el asfalto se derrita.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: No hay nada más estimulante para Ola Stenegard, diseñador de motos BMW, que viajar por California. Allí conocerá a leyendas de fama mundial como el diseñador Ronald Sands o los customizadores Michel "Wooley" Woolaway y Alan Stulberg. El fanático de los Porsche Magnus Walker descubre su admiración por las motos personalizadas.

programme.title: Ford Mustang en la cima del Empire State Building
programme.desc: Con motivo del 50º aniversario del Mustang, Ford desmonta un modelo y lo lleva a un lugar insólito: la cima del Empire State Building. Allí, los mecánicos recomponen las piezas y presentan el modelo de aniversario del legendario pony car.

programme.title: La Historia de Lamborghini
programme.desc: En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini tenía un sueño: quería construir el mejor coche deportivo del mundo. A pocos kilómetros de la sede de Ferrari. Su primer coche, el 350 GT, dejó en la sombra cualquier comparación con sus competidores de Maranello.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini se fijó el objetivo de construir los mejores coches deportivos del mundo, un movimiento audaz, al estar situado a pocos kilómetros de Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, siguiendo los pasos de su padre, que había sido responsable del desarrollo del clásico Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche sentó las bases de los modelos deportivos de la marca, como el 356 y el Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: No se puede hablar de rallyes sin mencionar el nombre de Walter Röhrl. Röhrl demostró su talento en los rallies desde muy joven y ganó varios campeonatos europeos, mundiales y otros internacionales a lo largo de su carrera.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: A lo largo de su dilatada carrera, Hans-Joachim Stuck no sólo ganó varias veces la Fórmula II y varios campeonatos internacionales de turismos, sino también las famosas 24 horas de Le Mans en dos ocasiones.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: Con sus coches V8, los estadounidenses demostraron a finales de los años 60 que también podían construir coches ganadores. El Ford GT 40 es uno de estos coches. Al principio, el proyecto "Victory at Le Mans" de Ford USA amenazaba con fracasar.

programme.title: Mustang
programme.desc: El Ford Mustang Shelby GT-500 nació de la vibra de los 60 y la experiencia en carreras de Carroll Shelby. Su estilo "boulevard cruiser" y su potente motor lo hicieron un éxito de ventas.

programme.title: Corvette
programme.desc: El Split-window Stingray Coupe de 1963 combinaba potencia, desempeño, precisión y diseño juvenil. Su estilo único, elegante y progresivo lo convirtió en un favorito eterno entre los fanáticos de los autos y los coleccionistas.

programme.title: Oldsmobile
programme.desc: El Oldsmobile F88 era el "auto soñado" de la línea de GM Oldsmobile, pero el auto, a pesar de su estilo sofisticado y encantador, no estaba destinado a entrar en producción.

programme.title: Pierce Arrow
programme.desc: 1913 38C Brougham - "construído con un estándar alto, no a precio reducido" - merecía el valor de varias casas del momento, con la distinción especial de ser el primer auto de la Casa Blanca.

programme.title: Duesenberg
programme.desc: El modelo 1930 J Duesenberg fue la cima de la ingeniería automotriz en potencia y velocidad, con récords que no fueron superados hasta 1960. Los magnates como Hearst, el rey de España y la estrella del cine Gary Cooper fueron dueños de Duesenbergs.

programme.title: Terraplane
programme.desc: El Terraplane 1937 Serie 72 de Hudson fue un auto rápido y asequible con estilo único y diseño innovador. Pero también era confiable y estaba bien construído, entonces la empresa, a diferencia de otras, sobrevivió la Gran Depresión.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Construcción ligera
programme.desc: Tuvimos la suerte de probar uno de los 29 Mercedes 300 SL "mariposa" construidos para su primera carrera de la Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia: Coche de ensueño y clásico de culto
programme.desc: Un proyecto ambicioso. En los años 50, el Facel Vega Facellia se desarrolló para competir con Porsche y Alfa y para llevar a la joven empresa automovilística francesa a un nuevo segmento de compradores. Un plan que sale terriblemente mal.

programme.title: 120 años de deportes de motor de Mercedes
programme.desc: El primer "Mercedes" se entrega a finales de 1900. Con su bajo centro de gravedad, su chasis de acero prensado y su radiador de nido de abeja, el Mercedes se considera hoy el primer automóvil moderno construido como coche de carreras.

programme.title: Velocidad
programme.desc: A lo largo de la historia, el intercambio humano llegó al océano. Innovaciones en navegación aceleraron el transporte marítimo, revolucionando el mundo al mover personas y bienes más rápido con fines comerciales y recreativos.

programme.title: Velocidad
programme.desc: Nunca antes la humanidad tuvo tanta movilidad. La demanda de transporte rápido, eficaz y seguro es altísima. Confiamos más que nunca en la tecnología: autos autónomos y trenes de alta velocidad nos impulsan hacia el futuro.

programme.title: McLaren 570 GT
programme.desc: Se supone que el 570 GT es el primer McLaren que no sólo es deportivo, sino sobre todo apto para las largas distancias. Comprobamos si este acto de equilibrio tiene éxito.

programme.title: McLaren 720 S
programme.desc: El McLaren 720S es el sucesor oficial del 650S y sigue unos pasos bastante importantes. Analizamos de cerca lo convincente que es en comparación con su predecesor.

programme.title: McLaren 570
programme.desc: McLaren se libera de la producción limitada y, con el 570S, lanza al mercado un nuevo modelo de entrada.

programme.title: McLaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: La competencia principal de McLaren es el automovilismo. Pero el 570 S Spider está diseñado para aportar prestaciones con estilo y elegancia británica a la carretera.

programme.title: Pagani Huayra
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos italianos inspiran a jóvenes y mayores. Y en este fascinante mundo, el Pagani Huayra es la gloria que canta.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan O CT
programme.desc: El Lamborghini Huracán, con su V10, es brutal, pero todavía hay quien piensa que ni siquiera eso es suficiente potencia. Por eso, la empresa suiza de tuning O.CT convirtió a este toro furioso en una bestia aún más furiosa.

programme.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS
programme.desc: Los grandes alerones traseros sugieren que hay mucha potencia escondida bajo el capó que debe ser controlada, ya que estos alerones proporcionan la carga aerodinámica necesaria. El Porsche GT3 RS tiene un alerón trasero muy especial.

programme.title: Nissan GT-R R35
programme.desc: Después de su lavado de cara, el Nissan GTR se presenta recién aerodinámico y más potente que nunca.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11
programme.desc: Con el Aston Martin DB 11, los británicos emprenden el camino hacia el futuro. Nuevo motor, nueva tecnología y un diseño que dará forma a todos los demás modelos.

programme.title: Tushek TS600
programme.desc: Es lo exótico entre lo exótico. No es un Ferrari ni un Lamborghini, sino que se llama Tushek TS600 y fue desarrollado por el piloto de carreras esloveno Aljosa Tushek. El concepto: un superdeportivo ligero con prestaciones reales.

programme.title: Bentley Continental GT3R
programme.desc: La edición especial del Bentley Continental GT3-R es un noble corredor limitado a 300 unidades.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini se fijó el objetivo de construir los mejores coches deportivos del mundo, un movimiento audaz, al estar situado a pocos kilómetros de Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, siguiendo los pasos de su padre, que había sido responsable del desarrollo del clásico Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche sentó las bases de los modelos deportivos de la marca, como el 356 y el Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: No se puede hablar de rallyes sin mencionar el nombre de Walter Röhrl. Röhrl demostró su talento en los rallies desde muy joven y ganó varios campeonatos europeos, mundiales y otros internacionales a lo largo de su carrera.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: A lo largo de su dilatada carrera, Hans-Joachim Stuck no sólo ganó varias veces la Fórmula II y varios campeonatos internacionales de turismos, sino también las famosas 24 horas de Le Mans en dos ocasiones.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: Con sus coches V8, los estadounidenses demostraron a finales de los años 60 que también podían construir coches ganadores. El Ford GT 40 es uno de estos coches. Al principio, el proyecto "Victory at Le Mans" de Ford USA amenazaba con fracasar.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: En la década de 1970 los modelos W 114/115 de Mercedes ofrecían una sólida tecnología a precios asequibles, lo que hizo que el sedán estilo Paul Braq se convirtiera en el primer Mercedes para la gente corriente. Y también: un discreto Volkswagen Escarabajo de 1972 con 90 hp que alcanzó los 180 km/h en la Autopista; un hito en la historia de la automoción: el NSU RO 80 con motor rotativo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cabe pensar que en la época comunista de Europa del Este solo había coches como el Trabant, el Wartburg o el Lada. Sin embargo, compañías como Tatra de Checoslovaquia introdujeron automóviles avanzados, incluso pioneros. Echamos un vistazo a algunos de estos coches clásicos, como un singular Tatra T87 de 1937, un Wartburg 311 y 312 y un Skoda 110R.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Porsche 911 Targa es un clásico y un buen ejemplo de descapotable emblemático. Y además: el ligero Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS es más para una carrera que un vehículo de carretera normal; el Bentley de 1930 de 4,5 litros Bentley es el Santo Grial de la exclusiva marca británica; el Sunbeam Tiger: un motor V8 de Ford USA propulsa este coche inglés de alto rendimiento un tanto delicado.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Ford Fairlane GTA de 1967 en la NASCAR no puede ser más americano. Y además: en 1995 el Chrysler 300 C fue el vehículo en serie más potente de los EE.UU. y fue apodado "The Bankers' Hot Rod". Y además: visitamos una de las mayores colecciones de Mopar del mundo; el Cadillac Serie 62 descapotable de 1949 estableció nuevos estándares de lujo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Land's End en Cornwall y John O'Groats en Escocia forman el punto de partida y de llegada del Rallye Le Jog, considerado por muchos el rally de coches clásicos más duro del mundo. Acompañamos a un equipo femenino alemán en este desafío con su Volkswagen Iltis todoterreno. Y también: el Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947, una reminiscencia de los tiempos de "Miss Marple"; el Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Jeep Willys
programme.desc: En 1940, la Segunda Guerra Mundial hace estragos. Los Estados Unidos no participan directamente al principio, pero proporcionan recursos. Reconocen la necesidad de vehículos de transporte ligero y se deciden por el concepto de Willys Overland Motors.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz Renntransporter
programme.desc: El equipo de Mercedes Classic ha revivido un mito con la reconstrucción del transportador de coches "Renntransporter". Al igual que en el pasado, el transportador azul lleva el coche del campeonato mundial de 1955, el W196, en su parte trasera.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka es un apasionado de la velocidad y constantemente participa en eventos de carreras, como la legendaria Race 61, a 50 kilómetros al norte de Berlín. Aquí es donde los participantes de toda Europa compiten en el Air-Strip del museo de la aviación en la carrera de un octavo de milla. Frank compite con su Dragster-Camaro de 700 caballos de fuerza para defender el título.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El empresario alemán Tillmann Miritz comienza su sueño en la ciudad que nunca duerme: un viaje por carretera con su propio coche vintage hacia los iconos automovilísticos de su juventud. Con su Mercedes 280 SE 3.5 descapotable visita al legendario distribuidor de coches clásicos Eliot Cuker de Nueva York, que hizo su fortuna con su pasión por los coches antiguos en el centro de Manhattan.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El recorrido de Tillmann Miritz para encontrar rarezas automovilísticas en los EE.UU. va desde el puente de Manhattan hasta Long Island. Su Mercedes descapotable lo lleva al viñedo Wöllfer Estate, donde se cultivan algunos de los mejores vinos. Su dueño esconde en el garaje una camioneta que representa el "American Way of Life" rural como casi ningún otro coche: el Chevrolet 3100.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati y Patrick son grandes fanáticos de los coches americanos y orgullosos propietarios de un Chevrolet Chevelle de 1972 pero quieren comprar un motor más grande. Por eso visitan a los especialistas de Down Town Garage con más de 50 motores. El lugar es también un restaurante americano con un motel donde puedes pasar la noche con un estilo genuino.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: En Paaren-Glien, cerca de Berlín, tiene lugar el show anual Oldtimer, que atrae a unos 45.000 visitantes ávidos por contemplar más de 5.000 tesoros automovilísticos. Frank y su equipo de Special Cars Berlin también asisten al evento trayendo consigo varios coches. Kati y Patrick viajan a Berlín con su Chevy. Al día siguiente, Fran participa en una carrera en el aeropuerto.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: El último barco americano de esclavos
programme.desc: El último barco que llevó esclavos a Estados Unidos estuvo oculto durante generaciones en los pantanos de Mobile, Alabama. Su hallazgo recuerda el pasado y confirma las historias de las familias que aún viven en este pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: Revolución Blockchain
programme.desc: La tecnología Blockchain domina el mundo. Pero ¿es segura? ¿Y es confiable para administrar todo, desde nuestra atención médica hasta nuestro suministro de alimentos?

programme.title: Apocalipsis de insectos
programme.desc: Una disminución alarmante en las poblaciones de insectos podría devastar toda la vida en la tierra. ¿Qué la causa y se puede hacer algo para detenerla?

programme.title: La búsqueda del supersubmarino japonés perdido
programme.desc: El I-400 fue uno de los submarinos Sen Toku de la Armada Imperial japonesa, los mayores construidos antes de la era nuclear. Más largos que un campo de fútbol, estos gigantes funcionaban como portaviones submarinos capaces de transportar aeronaves.

programme.title: El primero en el cielo
programme.desc: El 7 de enero de 1785, dos hombres aceptaron un arriesgado desafío: ¡Cruzar el Canal de la Mancha en un globo! ¡Ve a entusiastas modernos reconstruir los globos originales con herramientas del siglo 18 y revivir esta increíble aventura!

programme.title: La valentía de los hermanos Wright
programme.desc: Hace un poco más de 100 años, dos hermanos contemplaron el cielo y cambiaron el mundo. Diseñaron, construyeron y volaron la invención más ridícula. ¿Como lograron triunfar dos mecánicos de bicicletas donde el resto había fallado?

programme.title: Eclipse: Ciencia y Asombro
programme.desc: En 2017, dos eclipses solares cruzaron el planeta. Millones quedaron asombrados cuando la Tierra, la Luna y el Sol se alinearon, sumiendo regiones enteras en la oscuridad total. En América se vivió el eclipse más largo y espectacular.

programme.title: Jaguar XKR S
programme.desc: El Jaguar XK-RS descapotable con 550 CV es un británico con un temperamento ardiente.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: Es el mayor desafío tecnológico jamás emprendido por la humanidad. La búsqueda para producir la solución energética definitiva: fusión.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: El poder de las mareas oceánicas es la última gran fuente de energía sin explotar en la Tierra. Equipos de ingenieros compiten para perfeccionar la tecnología para aprovechar los flujos de agua.

programme.title: Momentos relevadores
programme.desc: En los primeros días de Internet, los usuarios de vídeo se veían afectados por la baja resolución y los largos tiempos de carga. La «red de distribución de contenidos» o CDN revolucionó la transmisión de vídeos y sentó las bases para la era de Netflix.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: El nuevo Bentley Continental GT es el modelo de éxito de la marca de lujo británica. Sin embargo, los británicos han registrado pérdidas en los últimos años. El último modelo tenía que ser un éxito para que Bentley recuperara su antigua fuerza.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Kia se considera una marca coreana. Hoy, sin embargo, la empresa es un actor global y produce la familia de modelos Ceed exclusivamente para y en Europa. Echamos un vistazo al proceso de diseño en Fráncfort y a la producción en Eslovaquia.

programme.title: Aston Martin Vanquish V12 y Rapide, Zagato
programme.desc: Echamos un vistazo a la fabricación del Vanquish V12 por parte de Aston Martin, comprobamos el Rapide y echamos un vistazo entre bastidores a Zagato.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: El BMW X5M, el Audi Q7, el Mercedes GLS y el Porsche Cayenne Turbo están entre los SUV más potentes y rápidos del mundo. Los utilitarios deportivos alemanes son la encarnación de la perfección técnica, las prestaciones superiores y un confort único.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Lujo, estilo de vida y exclusividad, ningún otro coche transporta estos atributos mejor que los SUV de Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo e Infinity. Estos SUV, elegantes y excelentemente equipados, encarnan el espíritu de las ganas de vivir.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los todoterrenos y camionetas estadounidenses como el Cadillac Escalade, el Chevrolet Tahoe, el Ford Raptor o el Dodge Ram son grandes, potentes y lujosos y desprenden la sensación de posibilidades y aventuras ilimitadas.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera 4S
programme.desc: En la segunda generación del Porsche Panamera, prácticamente todo es diferente. Óptica, tecnología y manejo

programme.title: Ford Mustang en la cima del Empire State Building
programme.desc: Con motivo del 50º aniversario del Mustang, Ford desmonta un modelo y lo lleva a un lugar insólito: la cima del Empire State Building. Allí, los mecánicos recomponen las piezas y presentan el modelo de aniversario del legendario pony car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: McLaren es una de las marcas de automóviles más famosas de Gran Bretaña. Apenas hay coches deportivos que fascinen tanto como un McLaren o que tengan una herencia tan legendaria en el automovilismo. Dos modelos recientes de McLaren son el 650S y la serie limitada P1. Supercars tiene ganas de amar y cita al McLaren 650S en una antigua zona industrial y en la pista de carreras.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hay detalles que diferencian a los supercoches de los coches normales y estos detalles son esenciales. Los supercoches son los coches más grandes, más ruidosos y más caros de la carretera; son obras de arte de cuatro ruedas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Para celebrar su centenario, Maserati se ha premiado a sí misma con un precioso coupé llamado Maserati Alfiere. Pero eso no es todo. La compañía invita a un viaje de Bolonia a Turín con los modelos más bellos de las últimas décadas. Supercars participa en este viaje con un Granturismo MC Stradale.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se llama Mulsanne, Bentely Mulsanne. El nuevo buque insignia de Bentley alcanza una velocidad máxima cercana a los 300 km/h, es lujoso como un hotel de primera clase y elegante como un traje de Armani. Supercars revela qué se siente al conducir un coche de ensueño como éste. Además: Supercars echa un vistazo al extraordinario Rolls Royce Ghost y al coupé de alta tecnología Mercedes S 63 AMG.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: El lujo no significa necesariamente perder el tiempo. El híbrido es una de las técnicas que promete un menor consumo de combustible con un motor aún potente. Lexus es el pionero en la electrificación de los coches. Supercars conduce el nuevo LS 600h, el BMW Actiev Hybrid 7 y el Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: La Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse, en Austria, es el terreno de juego ideal para los ligeros Lotus Elise y Roding Roadster. Estos dos roadsters están pegados a la calle y, por tanto, son muy divertidos de conducir.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: Es el mayor desafío tecnológico jamás emprendido por la humanidad. La búsqueda para producir la solución energética definitiva: fusión.
